# One in 20 adults now pays for an AI assistant

We track who pays for ChatGPT, Claude and other AI tools in de-identified records from 14 million UK bank and card accounts. We publish a new release every month. ## The paper

Who Pays for AI? documents how fast paid AI is spreading, how adoption differs by age, gender, earnings, occupation and place, and how consumers split their spending between ChatGPT, Claude and other tools.

Read the abstract and download the paper

## How we find AI payments

Every subscription leaves a line on a bank statement. We match direct payments to a registry of more than 200 AI products using the statement text, the exact price and the product's launch date. Subscriptions billed through the Apple and Google app stores hide the product name, so we estimate them from recurring charges at AI prices. We then weight the accounts to represent UK adults.
